TTJ3C and TTJ4C develop transportation and shop skills through measurement, CAD, fabrication, automotive systems, diagnosis, service, and documented project work.
:::

## Course path

The shared course structure will move through:

1. Starting Point
2. Identity, Marque & Shop Log
3. Measurement & Onshape
4. Fabrication & Shop Skills
5. Automotive Systems
6. Diagnosis & Service
7. Major Project & Portfolio

Detailed lessons and the course sidebar are added in the next curriculum iteration.
